# Function: as_user

Run an async callable with the given UserContext set for the duration.

Returns an awaitable coroutine.

```python
def as_user( user_context: UserContext, func: Callable[[], Awaitable[Any]], ) -> Awaitable[Any]
```

_Defined in `appkit.pyi`._
